[LECC.1.4] The maximum segment count is four. Codes deeper than
`<family>.<a>.<b>.<c>` are forbidden, and the compiler must refuse an `error`
pattern of more segments with `DS_VALIDATE_ERROR_PATTERN_TOO_DEEP`. Four levels suffice for the
families catalogued in §3 and bound the matching cost in
[LCCO.8.3.2].
